# Published by the course. Every student's checker reads this file over the
# network on each run, so these lines are the single source of truth for which
# week is being checked. The copy inside a student repository is inert.
#
# One line per section, because two sections do not stay in step: a public
# holiday falling on one section's day is enough to put them a week apart, and a
# single number would then be quietly wrong for one of them. A student's section
# comes from their student.json.
#
# Do not edit this file by hand — `grade.py week N --section X` writes it.
